BIG OIL 2Q EARNINGS: BP beats estimates, with adj net income of $5.7 billion (and a significant drop in total debt). More important the message from BP new-ish CEO; company needs to do a lot better:

“…Our performance over the past few years has not met our own expectations, let alone those of our shareholders. We have not delivered consistently; we have written off too much value; and our costs and liabilities are not resilient enough in a low price environment…”

She presented 5 priorities ⤵️

Also, BP has put up for sale Archaea Energy, a biogas business that it bought less than four years ago during the green energy bubble for more than $4 billion. Probably another write down in the making.
